strings.body: Interaction to Next Paint measures the delay from a click, tap or key press to the next frame on screen. It replaced First Input Delay as a Core Web Vital in March 2024.

strings.alt: Performance card. INP: how fast the page answers a tap. Interaction to Next Paint is good at 200 ms or less, needs improvement up to 500 ms, and is poor over 500 ms, at the 75th percentile of page loads. Spot it: find the slowest tap on your page and break up the long task behind it.
